extracted text: The study focuses on the S-N fatigue behavior of anodized 7050-T7451 aluminum alloy produced in different electrolytes (chromic acid, sulfuric acid, and tartaric acid). The alloy was supplied as a 100-mm-thick plate from Korea Aerospace Industry, Ltd. Figure 1 shows that the 7050-T7451 has a partially recrystallized microstructure with fine, equiaxed grains in large grains.
